True transparent background, not gray or a checkerboard. No labels, UI, watermark, frame, or second view. This is a static source sprite, not an animation sheet.

archiveRecords.exactPrompt:
Create exactly one individual static source asset for the CQC Metal Gear Atlas. Use the attached official KONAMI Metal Gear AC!D PSP screenshots as the sole visual authority. Isolate the named object, preserve its visible original low-polygon game silhouette, proportions, viewing angle, muted gray-green metal palette and simple faceted surface shading. Keep only the recognizable source details; do not modernize, redesign, add ornament or invent hidden mechanisms. Clean readable edges, restrained game-like rendering. One object and one pose only, centered with a clear transparent margin, entire visible object and attached mount or supports inside frame. True transparent background. Remove the character, room, wall, floor, HUD, text, target icons and unrelated scene objects. No labels, sheet, second view, dramatic lighting, ground shadow, explosion or action effects. This is a reference-based reconstruction candidate, not a claim of exact native pixels.
Subject: only the gray wall-mounted Gun Camera assembly on the LEFT of the source frame. Preserve its source oblique perspective, its dark rectangular rear housing on the upper left, the long faceted gray main assembly descending diagonally to the lower right, the central visible joint/support shapes, and the thin muzzle/front extension pointing toward the lower right. Keep all parts that visibly belong to the mounted assembly in the original, but no soldier, room, wall or railing. Preserve the source proportions and primitive polygonal construction; do not turn it into a hand-held rifle, tripod turret or Patrol-bot, and do not add extra barrels, ammunition belts, decorative panels or unseen rear structures. A single complete visible mounted gun-camera object with a transparent margin.
